edit.statement: Every ARM Cortex-M processor executes only the Thumb instruction set and cannot run 32-bit ARM (A32) instructions.
edit.subject: ARM Cortex-M processor

notes: Real: the ARMv6-M, ARMv7-M and ARMv8-M architecture manuals define Thumb-only execution; the RP2040 datasheet lists dual Cortex-M0+ cores. A rarely stated detail that models may not hold.
